description: This file defines a PHP driver for Microsoft Visual FoxPro database using ADOdb. It includes the class `ADODB_vfp` which extends `ADODB_odbc` and handles connection parameters, quoting, and query limitations specific to Visual FoxPro, along with the class `ADORecordSet_vfp` for managing record sets and meta information.

classes.name: ADODB_vfp
classes.description: Driver class for Microsoft Visual FoxPro using ADOdb, managing database-specific configurations and behaviors.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_vfp
classes.description: Class representing a record set for Visual FoxPro, managing metadata and record data retrieval.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Stub method for starting a transaction; always returns false as transactions are not supported.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Quotes and escapes a string for safe inclusion in a SQL statement.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Modifies the SQL query to limit the number of retrieved rows using TOP if ORDER BY is present.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the meta type of a given database field based on its type and length.
